text.content: Meridian Consulting's internal documentation: project classification tiers and staffing rules, severity ratings and escalation procedures, client communication and confidentiality standards, knowledge sharing protocols, and regional operational guidelines for Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, and the Nordic markets, including cross-regional engagement rules.

rich_text.plain_text: Why the description matters:

text.content: The Describe Knowledge field provides a natural language description of the content and purpose of the Document Store. This description guides the agent in understanding what kind of information the store contains and when it would be appropriate to query it. A vague description produces incorrect routing decisions. A precise description tells the agent exactly when to retrieve from this store versus when to answer from general reasoning.

Why this instruction is needed:

text.content: Without explicit guidance, the agent may answer policy questions from Gemini's general training data rather than retrieving from the Document Store. This instruction tells the agent when to use the knowledge source and what to do when it cannot find the answer.

Takeaway:

text.content: Connecting a Document Store to an Agent Node takes two inputs: the store selection and the knowledge description. The store selection tells Flowise where to retrieve from. The description tells the agent when to retrieve and what to expect to find there. Both must be precise.

rich_text.plain_text: Connecting a Document Store to an Agent Node takes two inputs: the store selection and the knowledge description. The store selection tells Flowise where to retrieve from. The description tells the agent when to retrieve and what to expect to find there. Both must be precise.

text.content: A connected but poorly described knowledge source produces an agent that ignores its own knowledge base and falls back to general reasoning which is indistinguishable from not having connected the store at all.
